description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeListAPI in the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin. It contains unit tests and integration tests for API endpoints related to employee listing, including testing the 'getAll' API method and verifying that other methods properly throw 'not implemented' exceptions.

classes.name: EmployeeListAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeListAPI endpoints, particularly the 'getAll' API method and ensuring other methods throw 'not implemented' exceptions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' endpoint of EmployeeListAPI with multiple test cases provided by a data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides a list of test cases for the 'testGetAll' method, sourcing data from 'EmployeeListAPITestCases.yaml'.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the 'create' method of EmployeeListAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for 'create' throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the 'delete' method of EmployeeListAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for 'delete' throws a 'not implemented' exception.
